meta.label: Foreign residents, all citizenships (2022)
meta.methodNote: Residents holding any foreign citizenship, by comune: ISTAT's own total, not limited to the nationalities this site tracks. Citizenship, not birthplace. Comuni ISTAT sends no total for are absent, not zero. Comuni whose ISTAT total is below the sum of the tracked nationalities that year (an upstream inconsistency in ISTAT's own data, seen in 2019 and 2020) are left out of the year.
